info.name: MarketCorp API
info.description:
Postman collection for the MarketCorp e-commerce API. All requests use the Supabase PostgREST endpoint for the products table.

Collection Variables:
- SUPABASE_URL: Base URL for the Supabase project
- SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: Public anon key for read access

Setup:
1. Set SUPABASE_URL = https://sjfwzwqynuykrqdmgtfl.supabase.co
2. Set SUPABASE_ANON_KEY = your legacy anon key from Supabase dashboard

variable.description: Base URL for the Supabase project. Set this to your Supabase project URL.
Supabase legacy anon key. Copy this from your Supabase dashboard under Project Settings > API > Project API keys > anon (public).
